verdict.rationale: Treasury Prime documents generating and retrieving branded monthly account statements for customers (docs-13). It also has a dedicated guide for creating and filing a 1099-INT for an account (docs-38), so both paper obligations in the story are covered by first-party features. missing for 10: explicit evidence that statements are generated automatically per account each month rather than on request, explicit evidence that 1099-INT documents are retrievable through an API endpoint, deeper reference-level docs, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
